NVT Name: Apache Tomcat HTTP PUT Request JSP Upload Code Execution Vulnerability
Summary: Apache Tomcat is prone to a code execution vulnerability.
Specific Result: It was possible to upload the file /openvasvt241992671.jsp. Please delete this file manually.
Impact:
Successful exploitation will allow remote
  attackers to execute arbitrary code on the target system.
Solution:
Upgrade to Tomcat version 7.0.82 or 8.0.47
  or 8.5.23 or 9.0.1 or later.
Affected Software/OS:
Apache Tomcat versions 9.0.0.M1 to 9.0.0,
  8.5.0 to 8.5.22, 8.0.0.RC1 to 8.0.46 and 7.0.0 to 7.0.81.
Vulnerability Insight:
The flaw is due to an insufficient processing
  of 'HTTP PUT Request', which allows uploading of an arbitrary JSP file to the
  target system and then request the file to execute arbitrary code on the target
  system.
Vulnerability Detection Method:
Send a crafted 'HTTP PUT' request and check
  whether it is able to upload arbitrary file or not.
